description: Shared column grid: equal ticks have equal x on both staves, equal measure widths.
testName: G3: equal ticks have equal x on both staves (beat 3 of measure 1: treble E5 vs bass G2)

description: Column union keeps a busy staff and a sparse staff aligned (quarters vs halves).
testName: T2: quarter notes against a half-note staff: equal ticks share x, equal barline x, equal width

description: Fixed 7.0 sp gap between staves, system height covers both.
testName: G1: one system with two staff containers, staff 1 lower by 4 + 7 sp, system height covers both

description: Barlines are drawn once and span from staff 0 to the last staff.
testName: G4: barlines are drawn once, span staff 0 top to the last staff bottom, and none is duplicated per staff

description: Brace stretched to the system span, left of the start barline.
testName: G9: the grand-staff template gets a brace stretched to the whole system span, left of the start barline

description: Group semantics: bracket none draws no brace; no group defaults to brace for multi-staff part.
testName: G10: group semantics: bracket "none" draws no brace; a part without a group defaults to a brace

description: Renderer stretches the brace with a non-uniform scale only.
testName: G12: the renderer stretches the brace vertically (non-uniform scale) and nothing else

description: Layout items carry staffId in multi-staff layouts; single-staff output has none.
testName: G2: every staff has 5 staff lines, a clef of its own and event items tagged with its staffId

description: Single-staff layout is unchanged (no staffId).
testName: G8: the single-staff result carries no staffId (unchanged format)

description: findStaff replaces index access.
testName: findStaff returns the staff with that id, also the second one

description: Staff switch keys BracketLeft/BracketRight (Turkish Q: G-breve / U-diaeresis), input mode only, keep measure/tick/voice, snap to event start, no wrap.
testName: S2: a tick in the middle of a lower-staff event snaps back to that event start, never forward

description: Keymap: staff keys only in input mode, no modifiers.
testName: K1: BracketLeft / BracketRight map to staff-up / staff-down in input mode only, without modifiers

description: Pitch context follows the staff of the cursor (bass staff does not read the treble staff).
testName: K4: after switching to the bass staff the pitch context comes from the bass staff, not the treble staff

description: Caret and beat guide sit in the staff of the cursor.
testName: K5: the caret and the beat guide of the bass staff sit 11 sp (4 + 7) below those of the treble staff

description: Status bar shows the staff position (Porte n/m) on multi-staff parts.
testName: K6: the status bar shows "Porte 2/2" (tr) / "Staff 2/2" (en) in input mode on a grand staff, and nothing on one staff

description: Mouse resolves nearest staff by y (M7b-3).
testName: P1: resolvePointerStaff picks the nearest staff by y, the midpoint tie goes to the upper staff

description: New Score template Piano (grand staff) via createGrandStaffScore.
testName: K7: the New Score dialog offers the single-staff and piano templates

description: Save and load keep both staves, clefs and the brace group.
testName: K9: a two-staff score round-trips through save and load (staves, clefs, group, notes)

description: Playback schedules both staves in time order.
testName: K8: playback schedules the notes of both staves in time order and lasts as long as the score

description: Selection (click, marquee) per staff under the pointer (M7b-3b); keyboard selection per staff was done in 3a.
testName: marquee, select, delete, undo and redo each work inside the staff under the pointer

description: Measured gate instead of a new cache: grand staff, 100 measures, keystroke-to-paint p95 18.4 ms (<= 30 ms), equal to the single-staff reference (18.4 ms). Evidence: docs/review/evidence/m7b2_bench_grand_baseline.txt. Incremental cache deferred (grand-200 p95 26.5 ms, worst run 32.8 ms max).
testName: captures grand-staff 100 and 200 measure multi-bench results

description: Skyline spacing: the gap between staves grows per system where content collides (min 7.0 sp, padding 1.5 sp); items are copied, the layout cache stays untouched.
testName: K2: colliding low treble and high bass notes grow the gap and no items of the two staves overlap

description: Mouse entry in an empty measure follows the grid of the active note value when a slot is at least 1.5 sp wide, otherwise stays on the first beat (M7b-6).
testName: M3: with a wide enough slot (quarter notes) an empty grand-staff measure maps x to the grid slot, in either staff, with its x on the same scale

description: Entering a note inside a rest splits the rest (rests before and after stay); keyboard cursors are unchanged.
testName: R1: entering a 16th at tick 720 of a whole-rest measure keeps rests before and after, filling the measure exactly

description: Beam grouping by half bar in 4/4: a two-beat window of eighth notes only becomes one group of 4; windows with rests or shorter values keep the per-beat rule (M7b-7).
testName: G1: 4/4 with eight eighths gives two groups of 4 by half bar and four groups of 2 by beat

description: Score-wide beamGrouping setting: undoable command, optional field (absent = beat), save/load round trip, validation, layout cache key.
testName: G7: setBeamGrouping is one undo step, redoable, and round-trips through save/load

description: The entering half of a tie across a system break starts right of the system header and has a visible forward length (it used to start at a fixed 6.0 sp and ran backwards).
testName: T1: the entering half-tie of a grand staff starts right of the clef and has a visible length

description: M7b-5 acceptance: Bach BWV 772 mm. 1-7 hand-entered fixture lays out without overlaps, with aligned columns and through barlines, plays 14 s with the tie as one note, and survives save/load.
testName: A3: events that start on the same tick in both hands share one x (aligned columns)

description: M7b-5 acceptance: Mozart K. 545 mm. 1-7 hand-entered fixture (two-note chords, Alberti bass, 16th-note runs) lays out with two-notehead chords, plays 14 s with 103 notes and survives save/load.
testName: K4: a two-note chord is drawn with two noteheads on the same x, one staff space-multiple apart

description: M7b-8 chord entry: Shift+letter adds the pitch above the top pitch to the note just entered (core helpers plus the Shift+C..B key mapping).
testName: C1: the first matching letter strictly above the top pitch (Mozart K. 545 chords)

description: M7a-5 multi-voice selection: a range with allVoices covers every voice inside the tick span, copy/paste carries all voices (clipboard version 2) and delete acts on all of them.
testName: V7: copying measure 1 (both voices) and pasting it at the start of measure 2 reproduces both voices

description: Note-name layer: a score setting (showNoteNames) draws derived Do Re Mi / C D E labels under notes, separate from lyrics and never stored on events; lyrics changes invalidate the measure layout cache.
testName: N5: lyrics stay on their own line and the command never touches events

description: M7c-1 time-signature symbols: MeasureDef.timeSigDisplay (common for 4/4, cut for 2/2) is drawn as one glyph, kept when measures are added, saved in the file, and validated.
testName: T2: 4/4 with display common draws the C sign once and no digits

description: M7c-2 fermata, breath mark and caesura: optional event fields, drawn by the notation layer outside the staff clear of stems, on notes and rests, on every staff of a grand staff, ignored by playback; H and Shift+H shortcuts, toolbar buttons. Also fixes dynamics on the lower staff.
testName: F3: second press puts the fermata below the staff, never inside it

description: M7c-2b tuplet entry: a triplet entry creates a complete group (entered event plus sibling rests), later entries replace single slots, groups must fit the (pickup) measure, plain notes cannot overwrite a tuplet slot; validation of ratio, duration and group completeness.
testName: TU3: the opening bar of Barge BWV 1030 fills exactly 3840 ticks with two triplet groups

description: M7c-2b tuplet drawing: one number per group on the stem side, one beam per group of three (two groups in a beat are two beams), no numbers without tuplets.
testName: L3: two groups in a row give two numbers, not one

description: M7c-2c hairpins: toggle command, validation, cleanup when events or measures are deleted.
testName: H4: deleting the end event removes the hairpin, no validation error remains

description: M7c-2c hairpin drawing: crescendo is narrow at the start and wide at the end, below the staff.
testName: H7: layout draws a crescendo under the staff, narrow at the start and wider at the end

description: M7c-3 ornament toggle: sets, same ornament removes, another replaces; rests are skipped.
testName: O1: toggle sets, the same ornament removes, another replaces

description: M7c-3 ornament validation: unknown values and ornaments on rests are errors.
testName: O4: validation accepts the four values and rejects unknown values and ornaments on rests

description: M7c-3 ornament drawing: SMuFL glyph above the staff and the note.
testName: O5: each ornament is drawn with its SMuFL glyph above the staff and the note

description: M7c-3 a fermata above on the same note sits above the ornament.
testName: O6: a fermata above on the same note sits above the ornament

description: M7c-3b grace notes: add, insert, remove and clear on the main note.
testName: GN1: add appends in order, an index inserts, remove takes the last or the given one, clear drops all

description: M7c-3b grace notes have no duration: the bar stays valid.
testName: GN5: grace notes take no time: the bar stays valid with graces on every note

description: M7c-3b grace notes validation: kind, duration, count, pitch, notes only.
testName: GN6: validation rejects unknown kind, unsupported duration, more than four, bad pitch and graces on a rest

description: M7c-3b grace notes are transposed with their main note and respect MIDI bounds.
testName: GN7: transposing a range moves the grace notes with their main note and respects the MIDI bounds

description: M7c-3b copy and paste carry grace notes and ornaments.
testName: GN9: copy and paste carry the grace notes (deep copy) and the ornament

description: M7c-3b grace note drawing: small head, stem, flag, slash for acciaccatura, left of the main note.
testName: GL1: a single acciaccatura has a small head, a stem, a flag and a slash, left of the main note

description: M7c-3b two or more grace notes are joined by a beam instead of flags.
testName: GL3: two grace notes are joined by a beam and have no flags

description: M7c-3b grace notes keep their distance to the main note when the system is stretched.
testName: GL5: the grace head keeps its distance to the main note when the system is stretched

description: M7c-3b a sharp on a grace note carries on in the bar.
testName: GL6: a sharp on a grace note carries on in the bar: the following natural note prints a natural sign

description: M7c-3b a changed grace pitch refreshes the cached measure layout.
testName: GL7: changing a grace pitch in place refreshes the cached measure layout

description: M7c-3b a slur joins the first grace note and the main note.
testName: GL10: a slur runs from the first grace note to the main note, one per group

description: M7c-3b grace entry: a letter adds a grace note in the nearest octave with the key signature accidental.
testName: GE1: a letter adds a grace note of the chosen kind, in the octave nearest to the main note

description: M7c-3b grace entry: Shift+Up/Down move the last grace note by a semitone.
testName: GE4: Shift+Up and Shift+Down move the last grace note by a semitone, within two accidentals

description: M7c-3b grace entry: Backspace removes, limit of four, Escape leaves, other keys pass through.
testName: GE7: Escape leaves the mode; other keys, modified keys, Shift+letter and an off mode are ignored
